carousel_caption:
You don't need English to grow. In 2016, India had 234 million Indian-language internet users and 175 million English ones.

Gaurav Chaudhary started Technical Guruji in October 2015, making tech reviews and advice in Hindi. By September 2018 it was the 9th most subscribed tech channel on YouTube. That November, he was reported as the first tech YouTuber to pass 10 million subscribers.

The same report that counted those users found 88% of Indian-language users are more likely to respond to an ad in their own language. That matters when brands come looking.

Try it: check your top cities in Insights, make one post fully in the language most of them speak, and compare its saves and sends with your usual.

Send this to a creator who's hiding behind English, and save it for your next post.

Sources: Wikipedia, "Gaurav Chaudhary"; KPMG and Google, "Indian Languages: Defining India's Internet" (2017), as reported by exchange4media
